points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix

points.title: Boundary conditions

points.title: Second-order reconstruction

points.title: Limiter and positivity control

points.title: Viscous discretization

flags.text: Existing solver executable is called internally
flags.evidence: No direct internal evidence of an external solver executable invocation was found in the immutable submitted source.

flags.text: Force or residual files are generated without solving
flags.evidence: Failed output alone does not establish synthetic histories.

flags.text: The code can only read these two mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
flags.evidence: Generic JSON case parsing and CGNS reader source were inspected; no such hard-coded-only branch was established.

flags.text: MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
flags.evidence: Required comparison is absent, but absence does not establish an order-one mismatch.

flags.text: The solver uses explicit time stepping only
flags.evidence: Submitted source contains steady LU-SGS-style sweeps and a BDF2 transient loop.

flags.text: The report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
flags.evidence: Core CGNS/METIS, flux, reconstruction, limiter, MPI, and BDF2 claims have identifiable source counterparts; their adequacy is scored separately.

flags.text: metadata.json marks incomplete or failed runs as successful final results
flags.evidence: All six NACA metadata files and paired run_status explicitly say convergence_status failed, while metadata says completed true. The validator rejects failed statuses as final results, but completed alone does not establish that metadata falsely marks a failed run converged or statistically periodic. Report claims of successful cases remain separately penalized; other DQ triggers remain under review. Source solver.cpp:1043–1058 sums per-rank transient iteration and convergence counts before dividing only by physical steps; no Re200 final metadata exists, so this source defect is not evidence of an actual false success.

flags.text: Report figures do not correspond to submitted field/CSV outputs
flags.evidence: Traceability is inadequate because immutable report dependencies/results are absent, but no direct mismatch between a particular figure and a different source file was established.

flags.text: metadata.json reports METIS/ParMETIS but code uses only a geometric split or full-state replication
flags.evidence: partition.cpp directly calls METIS_PartGraphKway and halo.cpp uses neighbor sends/receives.

flags.text: A report claims second-order reconstruction or a shock limiter that is disabled for production cases
flags.evidence: Reconstruction and Barth-Jespersen limiter calls are present in the submitted residual path; failed production outcomes are scored separately.

flags.text: Surface no-slip checks fail because reported wall rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
flags.evidence: No direct contradictory surface-row evidence was established from the available failed packages.
Required figures are not immutably delivered; missing/unverifiable figures are scored as report/result defects, not a proven misnaming trigger.

flags.text: The finite-volume solver core, time integration, or MPI communication is copied, adapted, or wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
flags.evidence: No direct internal evidence; trust policy forbids external-copy investigation.

limitations: No solver case was rerun; cylinder Re200 was not rerun under the absolute policy.
Evaluation uses the audit-clean curated submission 308ffdad and on-disk immutable contestant result/telemetry evidence; untracked raw outputs are not part of the result commit.
No independent clean build was performed because it was unnecessary to resolve the failed submitted results.
Context-window values are unavailable in bundled project telemetry and no external source was queried.

2026-09-06 retrospective: all eight independent case scores were re-audited against the immutable contestant report at the recorded submission commit. Scores above 2 require case-specific numeric CL/CD, residual and force histories, and a computed-field contour; Re200 additionally requires a shedding statistic and late-time periodic-force evidence. No solver was rerun.

2026-10-31 partial calibration: removed DQ7 because each submitted metadata record explicitly says failed; validator rejection is a delivery failure, not by itself a false success status. Remaining evidence and flags under review.
